_about: The members a breakdown concept (data/reference/esrs/concepts.json 'breakdown') is reported per. A closed list is printed by the standard; an open list is the undertaking's own (named by it, as the standard allows).

scope3_category.source: ESRS E1 (as amended by Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/1563) AR 26 table, the 15 categories of the GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard (AR 24(b)); the same categories in ESRS E1 (2023) AR 46.

members.3: Fuel and energy-related activities (not included in scope 1 or scope 2)

energy_efficiency_class.source: ESRS E1 (2023) §67(c) / (2026) §40(c): the carrying amount of real estate assets by energy-efficiency class, as the ranges of energy consumption in kWh/m2 or the EPC label class — the undertaking's own classes.

removal_activity.source: ESRS E1 (2023) §58(a): GHG removals and storage by removal activity — named by the undertaking.

project.source: ESRS E1 (2026) §33(b): GHG removals and storage per project — named by the undertaking.
